title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
description: Once the Demon King, now a shut-in NEET—Ryusei Narukami’s second life is anything but peaceful! When Meteor Hanaori, the Hero who once defeated him, suddenly returns as a normal high school girl, his world is thrown into chaos. Determined to change, Ryusei reenters society as a teacher and ends up teaching at her school! Their explosive reunion reignites the past—and sparks an unexpected love!

episodes_data.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The reincarnated Hero visits the reincarnated Demon Lord, and the former NEET becomes a teacher at her school.

episodes_data.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Meteor and Ryusei get to know the two new transfer students, and then their secret identities are revealed.

episodes_data.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Meteor and Ryusei discuss the food of their old and new lives. Then they go on a dungeon date.

episodes_data.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Ryusei fights off a Returner. Ryusei and Hanaori go through couples therapy.

episodes_data.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Ryusei resolves some of the girls' troubles. Then he goes on a not-date with Meteor.

episodes_data.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Hanaori gets turned into a cat. Then silenced. Then a magical girl from a parallel world attacks Ryusei.

episodes_data.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The witches gripe about their work for Oz. Hanaori gets corrupted and fights Ryusei.

episodes_data.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Meteor finds out the holy sword Ryusei gave her is worth 1 billion yen. Ryusei trains the witches.

episodes_data.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Ryusei deals with a robot from another world and ghosts at the cultural festival. Ayame faces her bullies.
